Description: Unique session record id.
Leakage_Notes: Never a feature.

Description: Session start time (synthetic site calendar, 180 days from 2026-03-01).
Leakage_Notes: Use only for time-based splitting / ordering.

Description: Generator scenario that produced the session. Not observable on a real machine.
Leakage_Notes: NEVER a feature for any model (would leak the generating process). Use for stratification and error analysis only.

Description: Machine identifier (EXC-2xx excavators, WHL-3xx wheel loaders).
Leakage_Notes: Do not one-hot as a feature (memorisation).

Description: Excavator or Wheel Loader.
Generic size class (e.g. Medium Excavator (20t class)). Not an official model name.
Cumulative engine hours at session start.
Years in service.
Coolant temperature (session average). Driven by engine load, ambient temperature, machine health; overheating scenario adds a fault offset.
Hydraulic oil temperature (session average).
Travel speed in the safety snapshot window (sensor noise σ≈0.2 km/h). Excavators ≤5.5, loaders ≤15.
Average fuel burn rate over the session (active burn blended with ~28 % idle burn).
Leakage_Notes: TASK: session aggregate – known only after work starts.

Description: Project-defined condition index (wear, maintenance quality, fault state). Not a CAT metric.
Average engine load (payload, slope, mode, task).
Operator identifier OP1000–OP1119 (OP1007 = demo operator).
Leakage_Notes: Do not one-hot for SAFETY/TASK. ANOMALY uses it only to look up the operator's own baseline.

Description: Novice (<2 y), Intermediate (2–5), Experienced (5–10), Expert (10+).
Years operating heavy equipment.
Morning 06–14, Afternoon 14–22, Night 22–06.
Operator's historical productivity index (profile, pre-window).
Operator's historical typical idle (noisy estimate of personal habit).
Latest training assessment score; drifts upward slowly over the 180 days.
Safety events recorded before the observation window.
Assessed skill (noisy measurement of latent skill).
Average payload per work cycle.
Load_Weight relative to typical class payload (>100 % = overloading).
Work cycles needed for the completed quantity.
Leakage_Notes: TASK: LEAKAGE – realised cycle count is only known at completion.

Description: Idle minutes during the session. Idle share of session time = operator habit ÷ 120 (habit expressed as min per 2 h).
Leakage_Notes: TASK: LEAKAGE – idle minutes are part of the realised duration. ANOMALY: primary input.

Description: Eco / Standard / Power.
Forward / Reverse / Swinging / Stationary in the snapshot window.
Harsh acceleration events in the session.
Leakage_Notes: TASK: leakage-risk (scales with duration). Use per-hour rate for ANOMALY.

Description: Harsh braking events in the session.
Leakage_Notes: Same as Harsh_Acceleration.

Description: Rapid joystick reversals in the session.
Leakage_Notes: Same as Harsh_Acceleration.

Description: Project-defined control smoothness index (higher = smoother).
Entries of any object into the 3 m restricted zone during the session.
Leakage_Notes: ANOMALY input (repeated violations). Not for SAFETY snapshot scoring.

Description: Fastened / Unfastened.
Distance to nearest object in the snapshot (sensor noise ≈8 %). 0.5–20 m.
Nearest object: Worker, Vehicle, Structure, Material_Pile, Utility_Marker, No_Object.
Object detected in a blind zone (more likely when reversing, close, low visibility).
Ground slope at the machine (sensor noise σ≈0.7°). 0–30°.
From Proximity_Distance: Violated <3 m, Warning 3–6 m, Clear ≥6 m (PROJECT thresholds).
Leakage_Notes: Redundant with Proximity_Distance.

Description: Emergency stop triggered.
Leakage_Notes: SAFETY: LEAKAGE – consequence of risk, not a cause.

Description: A safety event (near miss or incident) occurred. Bernoulli draw from ground-truth risk.
Leakage_Notes: SAFETY: LEAKAGE if used as input. Can be a secondary target.

Description: Clear, Cloudy, Hot, Light_Rain, Heavy_Rain, Dust_Wind, Fog (seasonal).
Estimated visibility index 0–100 from weather × lighting (sensor noise σ≈4).
Air temperature (month, shift, weather).
Dust index (terrain, wind, rain suppresses).
Dry, Wet, Muddy, Loose, Rocky (driven by weather + terrain).
Flat, Gentle_Slope, Embankment, Trench_Edge, Haul_Road, Stockpile.
Zone A–F; zones differ in terrain and ground-worker density.
Daylight, Dawn_Dusk, Night_Floodlit, Night_Poor.
Task identifier.
Leakage_Notes: Never a feature.

Description: Excavation, Trenching, Loading, Backfilling (excavator); Loading, Material_Transfer, Stockpiling (loader).
Planner-assigned complexity.
Planned quantity to move.
Quantity actually moved (<target if interrupted).
Leakage_Notes: TASK: LEAKAGE.

Description: This operator's historical duration for comparable tasks, scaled to the target quantity.
Leakage_Notes: Known before the task – legitimate TASK feature.

Description: Quantity-based progress at the snapshot.
Leakage_Notes: Legitimate TASK feature for remaining-time prediction.

Description: Planner's standard estimate (quantity ÷ standard rate + 20 % allowance). No operator or condition info.
Leakage_Notes: Known before the task – legitimate TASK baseline.

Description: Realised total duration (productive + idle + stoppages).
Leakage_Notes: TASK: LEAKAGE – this is (almost) the target. Can serve as target for a total-duration model.

Description: Fuel_Consumption × duration.
Leakage_Notes: TASK: LEAKAGE.

Description: Synthetic ground-truth risk index = 100·sigmoid(logit) built from TRUE conditions + unobserved operator awareness + situational noise. PROJECT metric, not a CAT metric.
Leakage_Notes: SAFETY: LEAKAGE for the level classifier (level is binned from it).

Description: LOW <30, MEDIUM 30–55, HIGH 55–75, CRITICAL ≥75 on Safety_Risk_Score (PROJECT thresholds).
Leakage_Notes: Primary SAFETY target.

Description: Session behaviour deviates ≥3 personal SDs from the operator's own latent baseline on any behaviour dimension.
Leakage_Notes: ANOMALY evaluation label (the detector itself is unsupervised).

Description: sigmoid(1.2·(max personal z − 3)).
Leakage_Notes: ANOMALY: LEAKAGE if used as input.

Description: Behaviour dimension with the largest deviation (Normal if not anomalous).
Leakage_Notes: Evaluation of explanation quality.

Description: Minutes remaining from the snapshot to task completion.
Leakage_Notes: Primary TASK target. Actual_Task_Duration must NOT be an input.

Description: Type of safety event (No_Incident if no event), sampled in proportion to the dominant risk term.
Leakage_Notes: SAFETY: LEAKAGE.

Description: Completed_Quantity ÷ Total_Fuel_Used (optional target).
Leakage_Notes: Uses outcomes – target only.
